params.body:
The garage's Inzichten (`/my-insights`), second round on the design system of #882, measured against what StockCars' real data looks like: one make with 48 sales and every other make 1 to 7, 34 cars in stock of which 15 over 90 days, about 30 viewed cars in a month.

## What changes on the page

- **Most viewed cars**: the window is in the heading ("Meest bekeken wagens, laatste 30 dagen", following the 30 / 90 days / 12 months choice). One line per car: name, views, leads. The split over the doors is one small groove beside the views in the chart's colours, its numbers in its label and title, instead of a strip of numbers under every name. Column heads are words ("Bekeken", "Aanvragen"), not bare icons. The first 10 show, "Toon nog 10" reveals ten more, inside a container that scrolls on its own.
- **Verkooptijd**: with real data almost every make read "te weinig". The main view is now the spread of days to sell over four spans (binnen 30 dagen, 31 tot 60, 61 tot 90, meer dan 90, both ends inclusive) as meters with count and share, and the answer "Je verkoopt in **26 dagen** (mediaan over 76 verkopen); 6 op 10 binnen 30 dagen." The per-make register keeps only makes with at least 10 sales; the rest is one sentence.
- **Leeftijd van de stock**: every car over 90 days is listed (91 days or more, oldest first), one line each with name, price and days in columns; the same "Toon nog" and scroll container. Before it listed 5.
- **Aanvragen**: when most leads have no source, the answer says the count and "Herkomst bijgehouden sinds 30/09/2026." instead of "de meeste zonder gekende herkomst".
- **Charts**: no day's figures stand under a chart before anyone asks. Under the bars it says how to read one; tapping or focusing a bar shows that step. The readout moved under the axis, so the bars do not jump on the first tap.
- **Layout**: two stacks from 1024px (views, cars, selling | leads, age, prices), each as tall as its own blocks, so a short block no longer stands beside a tall one with a hole under it. On a phone the stacks dissolve and the blocks keep their order.
- **Row heights**: every register row is one line of 32px on a wide screen; a row that is a link grows to 44px only on a phone. The price drops lost their second line (date and both prices are in the row's title and on the car's page) so they share that height.

## The design system

`<x-insights.register :step="10" :more-label="...">` is the long register: its own scroll container (ten and a half rows high, so the next row peeks out) and a "Toon nog :n" button that reveals a step at a time and moves the focus to the first revealed row. Rows past the first step render `hidden`, so the page is right before Alpine starts. The behaviour is an `x-data` object on the register, no window global. Documented in the components README together with the split groove, the meter's `share`, the row height and the column layout.

**Why the rows are in the payload and not loaded on demand.** The page is a Blade view with a cached answer per garage and window, not a Livewire component. `DealerInsights` now carries up to 100 rows per register (`CARS_LISTED`, `OLDEST_LISTED`, `PRICE_DROPS_LISTED`), which for a garage like StockCars is a few kilobytes, and "Toon meer" only unhides them: no second endpoint to scope to the garage, and the cache stays one answer. Above 100 the register ends in one sentence with the count.

## Figures

`DealerInsights::selling()` gains `buckets` (`SELL_BUCKETS`, count and whole-percent share); `age()` gains `over` and lists every car from `LONG_STANDING_FROM` (91) days. Both stay scoped to the garage like everything else. The cache version moves to 2 so an old shape is never rendered.

## Tests

- `AGarageSeesItsOwnFiguresTest`: the cross-garage check now also holds the sell-time spread (the other garage's twenty one-day sales would land in the first span) and the count over 90 days; new tests pin the bucket edges (0, 30 | 31, 60 | 61, 90 | 91, 400 give 2 each, 25%) and that 90 days is not listed while 91 is, with all 15 long-standing cars listed.
- `InsightsKeepTheirRulesTest`: a scrolling register shows its first step and hides the rest after it, with a "Toon meer" when it has more rows than shown; no register outside a scroll container has more than ten rows; column heads are words; a chart starts with its hint and every readout hidden, and every bar answers a tap and focus; the 44px row height lives only under the phone width.
- Rules R P2-13.3 to P2-13.9 updated (oldest cars: all over 90 days; the sell-time spread; one line per row; the heading with the window).

refresh.css is untouched; StylesheetSyntaxTest, TheThemeOverrulesEverySpacingClassTest and QualityRatchetTest pass.
params.title: Insights, round two: compact registers that show more on request, and the sell-time spread
